#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    cin >> N;

    string str;
    cin >> str;

    vector<int> b(N);
    long long res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        cin >> b[i];
        res += b[i];
    }

    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    int move = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N / 2; ++i) {
        if (str[i] == str[N - i - 1]) {
            cnt[str[i] - 'a']++;
            move++;
            res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1]);
        }
    }

    map<int, vector<int>> mp;
    for (int j = 0; j < N / 2; ++j) {
        if (str[j] != str[N - j - 1]) {
            int minVal = min(b[j], b[N - j - 1]);
            for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
                if (cnt[i] > move / 2) {
                    if (!(str[N - j - 1] - 'a' == i || str[j] - 'a' == i)) {
                        mp[i].push_back(minVal);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (cnt[i] > move / 2) {
            int left = cnt[i] * 2 - move;
            vector<int>& pos = mp[i];
            sort(pos.begin(), pos.end());
            for (int j = 0; j < left; ++j) {
                res -= pos[j];
            }
        }
    }

    cout << res << '\n';
    return 0;
}
